# Legacy save fixture

`v12_payload.bin` is the synthetic 3,568-byte format-1 payload shipped with
[LPS Companion](https://github.com/TME520/LPS-Companion-PicoCalc) (`tests/fixtures/v12_payload.bin`).
It was generated by the unmodified v1.2 application serializer. It is not user data.

It contains day 3 with flags 1025, expected weight 110.500 kg, actual weight
111.250 kg, and the note `Keep this original note`; XP is 90. Two closed days
are retained. Day 2 has flags 512, actual weight 111.500 kg, and note
`Yesterday from v1.2`.

`tests/test_storage.c` wraps these bytes in an `LPR1` `SAVE_A.BIN` envelope and
checks that this port still decodes them.
